annotations.title: J-code and Precedent S code lookup

description: Finds the code for a piece of work in an electronic bill of costs (Precedent S, PD 47 Schedule 2) by code or by the work done: phases P1 to P15, tasks T1 to T41, activities A1 to A10, expenses X1 to X15 and the matching J-codes, with each task's Precedent H budget phase.

kinds.description: Limit the search to these kinds of code.

query.description: A code (e.g. 'T19', 'JK10', 'A5') or the work done (e.g. 'trial bundle', 'Part 36 offer').

name: look_up_j_codes
title: J-code and Precedent S code lookup
